text_plain: Thirteen years. That's how long it had been since Taylor Swift performed at the CMA Awards. She started backstage with her Toy Story 5 song, I Knew It, I Knew You. Then Keith Urban joined on banjo, and she flipped into Our Song, her country hit from two thousand six! The twist? I Knew It, I Knew You lost Single of the Year to Ella Langley. But on November twenty-second, her performance clip was number one on YouTube's U.S. Trending Music chart.
